checklist.title: Falsify EIP-3529 refund cap: verify refund exceeds min(accumulated_refund_counter, gas_used/5)
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Construct a transaction that maximizes accumulated_refund_counter (e.g., clearing many storage slots via SSTORE) while minimizing gas_used. 2. After execution, extract the actual refund credited to the sender from the state diff. 3. Independently compute the expected cap: min(accumulated_refund_counter, gas_used / 5). 4. Assert actual_refund == expected_cap. 5. Attempt edge cases: gas_used = 0 (refund should be 0), accumulated_refund_counter = 0 (refund should be 0), accumulated_refund_counter exactly equal to gas_used/5. 6. Verify that no refund exceeds gas_used/5 under any combination of SSTORE patterns, including sequences that add and remove refunds within the same transaction.
executable_checks: Deploy contract that clears N storage slots; execute with varying gas limits; assert post-tx refund == min(accumulated_refund, gas_used/5)
Test boundary: set accumulated_refund_counter to exactly gas_used/5 and verify equality
Test zero-gas-used edge: ensure refund is zero when gas_used rounds to zero in integer division
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP3529-POSTCOND-001. Post-condition falsification: attempts to show refund can deviate from the min(accumulated_refund_counter, gas_used/5) formula. Covers nodes ACTION-APPLY-REFUND-CAP, STATE-ACTUAL-REFUND-DETERMINED, ACTION-CREDIT-REFUND-TO-SENDER, STATE-GAS-REFUND-APPLIED and edges EDGE-APPLY-CAP, EDGE-ACTUAL-REFUND, EDGE-CREDIT-GAS, EDGE-REFUND-COMPLETE.

checklist.title: Falsify EIP-6916 testnet reset: verify old chain state remains reachable after genesis recreation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. On a testnet supporting EIP-6916, deploy contracts and create state entries (accounts, storage, code) on the pre-reset chain. Record block hashes, state roots, and account data. 2. Trigger a testnet reset with a specified initial validator set. 3. After reset, attempt to access old chain state: query old block hashes via eth_getBlockByNumber, attempt to read old account balances and storage via eth_getStorageAt at old block references, try to sync from old chain head. 4. Verify the new genesis contains exactly the specified initial validator set and no carryover state. 5. Assert that all queries to old state fail or return null/empty. 6. Check that the new chain's genesis block has no reference to previous chain's state root. 7. Verify old chain data is not accessible via any RPC endpoint including debug/archive methods.
executable_checks: Pre-reset: store known values in contract storage; post-reset: query same addresses and assert storage is empty or inaccessible
Post-reset: verify genesis block validator set matches specification exactly
Post-reset: attempt eth_getBlockByNumber for pre-reset block heights and assert failure
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP6916-POSTCOND-001. Post-condition falsification: attempts to demonstrate old chain state survives a reset, violating the requirement that old state is fully discarded. Covers nodes ACTION-TRIGGER-RESET, STATE-NEW-GENESIS and edge EDGE-RESET-CHAIN.

checklist.title: Falsify dual call-depth invariant: attempt nested calls exceeding min(EVM_RECURSION_LIMIT, 1024)
checklist.bug_class: Call Depth Limit Bypass / Stack Overflow
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Deploy a contract that recursively calls itself, incrementing a depth counter at each level, and records the maximum depth reached before failure. 2. Execute with sufficient gas to not be gas-limited (use a high gas limit). 3. Record the maximum call depth achieved. Assert it equals 1024 (the EIP-150 limit, which is the minimum of 1024 and 12288). 4. Attempt to craft a scenario where the 63/64 gas rule under EIP-150 is circumvented (e.g., via STATICCALL, DELEGATECALL, or precompile calls) to push depth beyond 1024. 5. Separately, test whether providing extreme gas values allows reaching depths between 1024 and 12288, which would indicate only one limit is enforced. 6. Verify that at depth 1024, the call reverts regardless of remaining gas. 7. Test all CALL variants (CALL, STATICCALL, DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE) to ensure the limit applies uniformly.
executable_checks: Deploy recursive-call contract; execute with high gas; assert max depth == 1024
Test DELEGATECALL recursive chain; assert same 1024 depth limit
Attempt to bypass 63/64 gas retention via precompile interactions; verify depth still capped
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EVMINIT-INV-003. Related ambiguity: AMB-ETHEREUM-INIT-02. Invariant falsification: attempts to violate the dual depth limit by exceeding the effective minimum of EVM_RECURSION_LIMIT (12288) and EIP-150 (1024). Covers nodes STATE-EVM-EXECUTING, ACTION-NESTED-CALL and edge EDGE-INITIATE-CALL.

checklist.title: Falsify bitwise op stack invariant: verify AND/OR/XOR/NOT produce incorrect stack depth changes
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. For each binary bitwise opcode (AND, OR, XOR): push exactly 2 values onto the stack, execute the opcode, then measure stack depth. Assert stack depth decreased by 1 (net effect: -1). 2. For NOT: push exactly 1 value, execute NOT, measure stack depth. Assert stack depth is unchanged (net effect: 0). 3. Test with minimal stack (exactly the required operands) to detect underflow. 4. Test with near-full stack (1023 elements for binary, 1024 for NOT) to detect overflow. 5. Verify the pushed result is correct: AND(a,b) == a&b, OR(a,b) == a|b, XOR(a,b) == a^b, NOT(a) == ~a (mod 2^256). 6. Chain operations: push 3 values, execute AND then OR, verify final stack has 1 element with correct value. 7. Test edge values: 0, MAX_UINT256, alternating bit patterns.
executable_checks: Execute AND(0xff, 0x0f) in EVM bytecode; assert result == 0x0f and stack depth reduced by 1
Execute NOT(0) in EVM bytecode; assert result == MAX_UINT256 and stack depth unchanged
Chain XOR then OR on 3 stack values; verify final single result is correct
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W1-CANCUNBIT-INV-003. Related assumption: ASSUM-CANCUN-BIT-01. Invariant falsification: attempts to show binary bitwise ops do not have net stack effect -1 or that NOT does not have net effect 0. Covers nodes ACTION-POP-TWO-OPERANDS, ACTION-POP-ONE-OPERAND, ACTION-PUSH-RESULT, STATE-INSTRUCTION-COMPLETE and edges EDGE-GAS, EDGE-INC-PC, EDGE-DONE.
